resumeText:
JAMES CARTWRIGHT
Brisbane, QLD | 0400 123 456 | james.cartwright@example.com | linkedin.com/in/jamescartwright
Australian Citizen - full working rights

SUMMARY
Recent IT graduate with hands-on experience building web applications during internship and university projects. Comfortable working across the stack from database design to responsive UI, and keen to continue developing skills in a full-stack developer role in Brisbane.

SKILLS
JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, HTML/CSS, Git, Docker, AWS, Kubernetes

EXPERIENCE

Software Engineering Intern - Bramble Digital Solutions, Brisbane
03/2023 - 08/2023
- Built and maintained REST API endpoints in Node.js/Express used by the internal client portal.
- Fixed 14 bugs reported through the support tracker, reducing the open bug count from 22 to 8 over the internship.
- Wrote unit tests with Jest, lifting test coverage on the orders module from 40% to 75%.
- Participate in daily stand-ups and sprint planning with a team of five developers.

Helpdesk Support Officer (Casual) - Coral Bay Retail Group, Brisbane
11/2021 - 02/2022
- Resolved point-of-sale software issues for store staff over phone and email.
- Documented common fixes in a shared knowledge base article used by other support staff.

Junior Web Developer - Nettle & Co, Brisbane
06/2022 - 04/2023
- Developed and styled marketing landing pages using HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript for small business clients.
- Lead the migration of three client sites from a legacy CMS to a static site generator.
- Coordinating with clients directly to gather requirements and provide revisions.

PROJECTS

Campus Marketplace - Full-stack web app for buying and selling secondhand textbooks between students.
- Designed a PostgreSQL schema with 8 tables covering listings, users and messaging.
- Implemented JWT-based authentication and a React front end with search and filtering.
- Deployed the app for a class demonstration attended by 20 students.

Budget Tracker CLI - Command-line tool for personal expense tracking.
- Built with Node.js, reading and writing to a local JSON file for persistence.
- Added CSV export feature so users could open reports in Excel.

Recipe Sharing Platform - Group capstone project for a social recipe-sharing site.
- Contributed the comment and rating system using Express and PostgreSQL.
- Presented the project to a panel of three industry judges as part of the final assessment.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Information Technology
Griffith University, Brisbane
02/2020 - 11/2022
- Relevant coursework: Web Application Development, Database Systems, Software Engineering Principles, Cloud Computing.
- Capstone project: Recipe Sharing Platform (see Projects).

CERTIFICATIONS
- freeCodeCamp - Responsive Web Design Certification, 2021
